source.snippet: I am seeking to improve my AEO strategies. I've added lots of JSON to my sites however I get the feeling I keep needing to re-train AI responses, which seems to put me in a redundant loop. Are there any errors in search console that can improve these? I feel like my mobile results are worse than desktop.

problem_statement: Website owners and SEO practitioners investing in Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) for AI-powered search results have no reliable feedback loop — Search Console does not surface AEO-specific errors, AI responses are opaque and shift unpredictably, and practitioners cannot tell whether their structured data changes are being picked up or ignored.
target_segment: SEO professionals, content marketers, and agency practitioners managing websites that rely on organic search traffic, especially those already paying for SEO tooling
notes: The question implies the person is actively investing time and money in AEO (adding JSON-LD schema, monitoring search console) — this is professional spend context, not curiosity. The 'redundant loop' frustration around re-training AI responses is a real emerging pain as AI-driven search surfaces grow. No established tooling exists yet for AEO auditing equivalent to what Ahrefs/SEMrush do for traditional SEO — gap for a paid monitoring/diagnostic product. Buyer willingness-to-pay is inferred from existing SEO tool spend patterns in this audience.
